daily_summary: Netflix signs major content licensing agreement.
Netflix appoints new Director of Brand Partnerships for Asia Pacific. - Netflix board member Anne Sweeney resigns.
Netflix game developer Refactor Games lays off 85% staff. - You Tube Premium bundles Peacock, increasing streaming competition for Netflix.

Netflix and Disney exploring free, ad-supported streaming tiers. - Netflix considering launch of new, always-on TV channels. - Netflix director plans to sell 2,160 shares. - Netflix stock may be 26% undervalued.

Netflix nearly doubled ad commitments at 2026 Upfront. - Netflix CFO sells 9,248 shares at $75.79 average price. - Netflix ad revenue expected to hit $3 billion in 2026. - Netflix ad commitments nearly doubled year over year. - Netflix ad business is starting to scale.
Netflix rated Buy with $106 target. - Netflix ad revenue doubles to $3B.
Bill Ackman's Pershing Square re-enters Netflix with a new stake. - Netflix doubles down on live sports with a massive push.
Coatue Management cuts Netflix share stake by 31.7%.
Bill Ackman buys Netflix at compressed valuation.
Netflix stock slips on revenue and earnings guidance concerns.
